goal: Audit the existing commonMain Compose UI implementation for Material 3 semantics, cross-screen theme/token consistency, typography and shape hierarchy, contrast-role use, icon semantics, touch targets, inset ownership, and redundant icon-plus-text actions without modifying production code.
acceptanceCriteria: Every production Compose screen and shared navigation/theme primitive is inspected.
Findings cite exact files and symbols and separate objective defects from stylistic opportunities.
The audit includes API-maturity notes for any proposed M3 Expressive replacement and a concrete minimal implementation plan.
